figures.title: Worker participation in the gig economy is trending downward.

errors.source_evidence: The source figure is a stacked bar chart with two bars (2023 and 2025). Gray segments show 66% and 77%; yellow segments show 34% and 23%, with a connector line between the bars.
errors.html_evidence: The rendered HTML has only a text description, a legend list, and a table. There is no visual chart: no bars, no segment value labels, no axis category labels (2023/2025) attached to bars, and no connector line.
errors.correction: Render the stacked bar chart visually. Draw two bars labeled 2023 and 2025. Stack gray 66%/77% above yellow 34%/23%, with each value label inside its segment, a baseline, a legend with color swatches, and the connector line. Keep the data table beside it.

figures.title: Employers expect to use more freelance workers in the future.

errors.source_evidence: The source shows two stacked bars (Today, In five years). The bars use color-coded segments for 50% or more, 25% to 49%, 10% to 24%, Less than 10% and None, with the percentage labels inside the segments.
errors.html_evidence: The render has no visual chart. It shows only a bullet list of legend names with no color swatches, two prose lines and a table. The section labeled 'Stacked bar chart' draws no bars.
errors.correction: Render the stacked bar chart visually. Draw two 100% stacked columns, Today and In five years, with segments in the correct order and color. Use a color-keyed legend and place each value label on its segment. Keep the data table alongside the chart.

errors.source_evidence: The bracket on the Today bar spans the top four segments (4+8+16+37) and is labeled 65%. The bracket on the In five years bar spans the top four segments and is labeled 77%. The 4% label sits outside its segment, joined by a leader line.
errors.html_evidence: The 65% and 77% values appear only as a 'Bracket annotation' table row and in text. They are not tied to the segments they cover.
errors.correction: Show the brackets beside their bars. Label 65% (Today) and 77% (In five years) as spanning the segments from 50% or more down to Less than 10%, or state that scope in the table or caption. Keep the 4% label connected to its top segment.

errors.source_evidence: The legend is a boxed panel at the top right of the figure, beside the question text, with the stacked bars below it.
errors.html_evidence: The legend is a boxed panel below the question text and left-aligned. The flex-wrap layout pushes it down, leaving a large empty area on the right of the page.
errors.correction: Place the legend at the top right beside the question, as in the source. Widen the figure container or stop the top block from wrapping.

errors.source_evidence: The source labels the right bar "In five years". The 77% bracket starts at the top of the bar and ends at the top of the 'None' segment (the bottom of the Less than 10% segment). The 65% bracket ends at the same boundary on the Today bar.
errors.html_evidence: The 65% bracket and 77% bracket heights are set as a percentage of the bar. The Today bracket height is 65% and the five-years bracket is 77.5%, but the bar's rendered x-label reads "In five years" while the rendered screenshot text shows "In five years" wrapped inconsistently with the source. The 4% leader line is detached from the Today bar's orange segment and sits beyond the bracket gap, rather than touching the segment as in the source.
errors.correction: Position the 4% leader so it connects directly to the orange segment's right edge, and keep the bracket aligned with the bar's top edge and the 'Less than 10%' boundary on both bars.
